faq.q: Which is the best country to study abroad?
faq.a: It depends on your course, budget and career goals. The UK has 1-year Master’s degrees, Canada offers post-graduation work permits, the USA is strong in STEM and Germany has low or no tuition at public universities. Your counsellor matches you to the right country for your profile.

faq.q: How much does it cost to study abroad?
faq.a: Costs depend on the country, city and university. We help you plan tuition and living costs, and guide you on scholarships and education loans with our partner banks.

faq.q: Can I study abroad without IELTS?
faq.a: Often, yes. Many universities accept PTE, TOEFL, the Duolingo English Test or a Medium of Instruction certificate. Your counsellor checks what your chosen universities accept.

faq.q: Can I work while studying abroad?
faq.a: Most student visas allow part-time work during term time, and many countries offer post-study work options after you graduate. Rules differ by country and change from time to time, so your counsellor will give you the latest.

faq.q: When will a counsellor contact me?
faq.a: Usually within 24 hours, on WhatsApp or a phone call.
